verdict.rationale: Framer's developer docs advertise a Server API to bring Framer into your product, automate publishing, and connect external agents. A Plugin API can also interact with the editor and CMS, and external agents can read, write and delete CMS items, with changes isolated on branches. The evidence is all first-party and stays at the headline level, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, which limits machine-readable discoverability without contradicting that the API exists. Missing for 10: endpoint/auth/coverage reference detail for the Server API, a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
